name: Norion Bank
summary: Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Norion Bank AB, established in 1999 and formerly known as Collector Bank AB until its rebranding in September 2023, delivers comprehensive financial solutions. The bank primarily serves small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) alongside individual customers across Sweden, Finland, Norway, and beyond. Its business activities are organized into distinct Corporate, Real Estate, Consumer, and Payments divisions, encompassing various forms of credit, factoring, payment processing, and installment payment services.
